messages:
Lucy: FYI PR 421 preview failed after last rebase: linkcheck + vale + md-lint. Link to PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/421
Raj: Can you paste the preview bot output?
Lucy: preview-bot shows: 
- linkcheck: 1 broken internal link to 'on-premise-install'
- vale: rule 'HeadlineCapitalization' flags 'Deploying on Premise' (suggest title-case)
- md-lint: trailing spaces in docs/setup/on-prem.md and YAML frontmatter date format warning
Oliver: I moved that section into docs/setup/private/on-prem-deploy.md last week; looks like the slug changed. I can update references.
Lucy: Great. I also want to keep Vale's suggestion consistent across guides. If it's suggesting Title Case we should align guide titles.
Raj: For the trailing spaces and frontmatter, I can run the auto-fix. Plan: make a small follow-up PR that updates links, normalizes titles to Title Case, and strips trailing whitespace. Thoughts on commit breakup?
Oliver: Keep link fix separate from content-style changes so reviewers can focus. Two commits in one PR is fine; reviewers can ask for split if needed.
doc-bot: Preview build failed for PR 421  linkcheck:1, vale:1, md-lint:2. See <preview:staging/421>.
Lucy: I'll open PR 422 with three commits: 1) anchor/link updates, 2) title capitalization batch, 3) whitespace/frontmatter fixes. Running local checks first.
Raj: Local commands I ran: 
```
./bin/docs-lint --fix docs/setup/private/on-prem-deploy.md docs/guides/deploying.md
npx vale --no-exit docs/guides/deploying.md
```
Lucy: Nice. Include brief PR description listing which rules each commit addresses.
Oliver: I pushed commit 1 (link updates). PR 422: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/422. Tagging @raj for the style fixes.
preview-bot: Preview build queued for PR 422  staging/422
Raj: Reviewing commit 2 (title normalization): a couple of titles needed manual adjust to keep clarity. Left minor suggestion on wording for 'On-Premise' -> 'On-Premises'.
Lucy: Good catch. 'On-Premises' is the preferred term in our style guide. I changed the titles accordingly.
preview-bot: Preview build complete  status: linkcheck pass, md-lint pass, vale: 1 suggestion remaining (headline style differences in migrating docs), spellcheck: pass.
Oliver: Vale warning is only in older migration docs the title still uses sentence case. We can run a follow-up sweep.
Raj: Approving PR 422. :thumbsup:
Lucy: Merging now. Thanks all.
doc-bot: PR 422 merged by lucy  release note: docs: fix internal link, standardize guide titles (Title Case), strip trailing whitespace.
Oliver: I'll schedule a separate issue to run title-case normalization across the docs repo and add a Vale rule exception list if needed.
